s01707.summary: Louisa examines the open grandfather clock while Barney watches from behind his bench.
Louisa interrogates Barney about the stopped clock and the dead man's repairs.
Louisa finds gold dust on the pendulum, and Barney falls silent.
Barney spills the gold dust and implicates the victim's widow.
Louisa closes her eyes as the clocks strike the half hour.

s00863.summary: Caspian types alone in the dome until the telescope moves by itself.
Odette emerges from the shadows, soaked, and warns Caspian away from the phone.
Caspian demands to know who sent her; Odette says she is the one who stays.
Odette shows she knows his purpose and that the telescope moves when watched.
Odette makes Caspian sit and asks him to tell what he saw.

s00888.summary: Margot, Oskar, Petra and a nervous new hire are introduced on the rooftop apiary.
Margot greets the new hire with a bogus title and dismisses Petra.
Oskar veils the new hire, and a bee lands on his shoulder.
Margot pitches hive harmony as a metaphor for sales; Oskar and Petra undercut her.
Oskar reveals Margot's late husband kept the bees, leaving her shaken.
Margot names Kwame, tells Oskar to teach him everything, and exits.
Oskar teaches Kwame to smoke the hive and the bees settle.

s01836_0.summary: A sun-bleached desert town with a telegraph office and one tied horse.

s01168.summary: The cast and crew bustle through pre-show chaos in the cramped green room.
Franco panics over curtain time while Biff hunts his boot and Romy rehearses to a parrot.

s00682.summary: Four people gather in the dim library as Beatrix pours drinks for the men.
Beatrix and Augustin press over the clause, and Hester admits the study door was open.
Hester reports four torn ledger pages, and Beatrix notes there are four of them.
Augustin orders the hidden pages fetched and lifts a poker across his knees.

s01170.summary: Ines drills into the projector while Toby and Kofi assist the heist.
Kofi bluffs the guard over the radio that the noise is pipes.
Ines opens the casing and reveals the velvet-wrapped silver sphere.
As the guard opens the door, the three hide behind the projector, armed.
The guard leaves and the crew scatters to the loading dock with the sphere.

s00242.summary: Isolde rations water to the weary survivors and admits rescue may take days.
Mags spots a light on the horizon and the others scramble up hopeful.
The speck is a gull; Mags laughs and cries while Isolde steadies her.

s01641.summary: Four people wait in the rainy greenhouse as a stranger steps in.
Solano questions the stranger, who gives the name Calder; Baptiste says Calder is dead.
The stranger reveals himself as Calder and says he came to return something.
Solano has Hester and Kieran clear the room, and Hester locks the door.
Calder produces Baptiste's watch and accuses him of shooting him.
Solano orders Calder to put the watch down as it ticks to a stop.

s01324.summary: Amos hauls the ferry rope while Del rides across the river.
Del pays the fare and fishes for information about a man; Amos gives little.
Del helps Amos haul the drifting barge steady.
A thump under the hull startles them, then they laugh it off as a log.
Del offers another nickel for speed; Amos says the river takes no bribes.

s01785.summary: Kruger tracks a sniper in the mill while the monk notes he is a boy.
Bogdanov relays orders to hold; Kruger dismisses command.
Anselmo asks to ring the bell to show they are still alive.
Kruger relents, orders the window covered, and allows one ring.

s01624.summary: Tanya walks through the dead pinsetter room to meet Shorty and his duffel.
Tanya and Shorty spar over who opens the duffel, and she finds it short.
Tanya accuses Shorty of skimming nine thousand; he evades with talk of her mother.
Tanya's flashlight in his eyes sparks a brawl; she pins him against a machine.
Tanya finds a hidden gym bag holding all of Dominic's money.
Shorty shows his phone, says he called Dominic, and armed men crash in.

s00995.summary: The family gathers for Thanksgiving on a bowling lane, and Imogen arrives late.
Family members bicker about lateness, dry turkey and where to eat.
Dorothea needles Imogen as the one who left, and the sisters spar.
Dorothea slams gravy onto Hal's tie, and he bowls a strike through dinner.
Everyone laughs, tension breaking as Walter says nice and Hal bows.

s01562.summary: The doctors give Hollis numbers about his tiny daughter; he wants more than statistics.
Hollis says her name is Matilda, and Perpetua says she speaks it every shift.
Hollis asks to hold her; told not tonight, he asks what if the numbers fail.
A monitor chirp is only a pump; Saoirse holds Hollis's hand and explains.

s01735.summary: Sleepless Lennox guards a lockbox in the dawn bait shop, on the phone.
Mama Pearl says a strange man has waited on the dock since midnight.
Lennox opens the lockbox of cash and says he will carry it out.
Mama Pearl says the money isn't the thing, and Lennox resolves to give it back.
Lennox hangs up and carries the lockbox to the end of the dock.

s00845.summary: Soldiers bake bread in a ruined cathedral while the lieutenant checks quotas.
Elias and the soldiers trade dry banter on damp flour and the cathedral.
Haruko recalls her grandmother's rice cakes and writes home every Sunday.
Elias says edible is excellent, and Haruko pockets a page and counts hours.

s00713.summary: Constable Idris questions Eleanor about her husband while Gerald stays turned away.
Gerald says Henry walked toward the river, though the allotment is the other way.
Eleanor retreats to make tea, and Gerald says she hasn't slept.
Idris notices the walking stick by the door is wet, perhaps from the river.

s01346.summary: Bleeding Teague tries to stand and scuffles with the doctor and nurse.
Teague explains his daughter waits outside, and Dao promises to fetch her.
Teague lies back, trusting the doctor to fix his arm.

s02198.summary: Six figures face off on the frozen dock: cops, an informant, criminals and a child.
Vasquez tells Blake no deal with the girl present; he signals Silas.
Marisol bursts in crying her daughter's name, and Ashley finally speaks.
Guns are drawn, Marisol lunges, and a shot rings out; Ashley looks calm.

s01019.summary: Bernadette, Willem and Jasper sit tensely in the storm-lit rocking galley.
The phone rings and Bernadette answers; Arlo asks for Willem.
Arlo apologizes through static about the will; Bernadette tells him to say it himself.
Willem snatches the receiver and coldly challenges Uncle Arlo while Bernadette resumes knitting.

s00830.summary: Jeb and Cyrus exchange fire across a dry creek as Ruthie calls from the burning wagon.
They quarrel over a hat, and shots keep them ducking.
Ruthie shouts that Jeb never fired, and both rifles point at each other.

s01432.summary: Estranged siblings wait wordlessly at an empty baggage carousel.
Yusuf offers his sister half a pretzel and they chew shoulder to shoulder.
They talk about their mother; Yusuf mutters about ten years.
The last bag arrives, Yusuf collapses inside, and Saoirse takes his hand.
Yusuf learns she knew about the house, and says it was never about Mum.

s01685.summary: Priya's team works a critical, hypotensive patient while the resident follows orders.
Paramedic Gus bursts in with news of nitro; the patient crashes into flatline.
Priya shocks the patient twice, pressing a hesitant Ingrid, until a pulse returns.
Ingrid exhales and Priya wipes her brow in relief.

s00123.summary: Naomi shapes loaves peacefully in the warm proofing room.
Linnea arrives unexpectedly early with a suitcase, and neither crosses the room.
They tease, confess missing each other, and apologize at once; tension breaks.
Naomi asks her to stay for the morning bake, and they work together.
Linnea produces an envelope with a hospital seal for Naomi to read.

s00686.summary: Brenda announces a pivot to hypersynergy while the staff mock it quietly.
Priya points out falling numbers, and Gus asks what hypersynergy means.
Trevor says it means layoffs; Brenda puts him on a performance plan.
Trevor quits, Priya seconds, and Gus asks if interns count.
Brenda smiles through it and calls fifteen minutes before circling back.

s01765.summary: Miners work the glowing vein deep in the shaft until the wall exhales.
Aldreth orders everyone still; the miners back away as the stone cracks.
Gorran appears, stops the cracking, and says they dug into the nursery.
The miners submit, and Gorran pinches out Pip's torch.
